g.text: DEPRESSION
low + joyless +
tired + hopeless
2+ WEEKS!
ANXIETY
worry + restless +
tense + sleepless
6+ MONTHS!
PSYCHOSIS
voices + beliefs +
disorganised +
withdrawn!
DEPRESSION (exam!): low mood + anhedonia (joyless!) + fatigue + worthlessness +
sleep/appetite shift + poor focus + SLOW or agitated + suicidal thoughts — 2+ WEEKS,
daily, function IMPAIRED. Postnatal: + bonding failure + intrusive harm-fears (M06.2!).
ANXIETY (GAD!): EXCESSIVE worry + restlessness + tension + poor focus + irritable +
sleepless — 6+ MONTHS, uncontrollable. Panic: sudden terror + pounding + "dying!" —
breathe WITH them + rule out MEDICAL (thyroid! asthma! drugs!).
PSYCHOSIS: HALLUCINATIONS (voices!) + DELUSIONS (fixed false beliefs!) + disorganised
speech/behaviour + NEGATIVE (flat, withdrawn, self-neglect!). Schizophrenia vs brief vs
drug-induced vs MEDICAL (UTI! malaria! typhoid delirium! — rule out FIRST!).
SUBSTANCES: alcohol (akpeteshie! pito! beer!) + tramadol + wee + cocaine — CAGE-ish ask:
Cut down? Annoyed? Guilty? Eye-opener? Withdrawal DANGEROUS (seizures! DTs!) — medical,
never "tough it out". MI spirit (M05!) + refer, judge never.
SCREEN (PHQ-2/GAD-2!): "down/hopeless…? little interest…?" + "nervous…? can't stop
worrying…?" — positives → PHQ-9/GAD-7 + suicide ask (M06.2!) + refer. Two questions,
every chronic/antenatal/postnatal visit — depression HIDES in diabetes, HIV, TB queues.
MEDICAL FIRST: thyroid, anaemia, UTI, malaria, drugs (steroids! efavirenz!), alcohol —
rule OUT before "it's psychiatric". Confusion + fever + age = DELIRIUM until proven
otherwise (GER M5!). Nurses catch what labels miss.
LANGUAGE: "person with schizophrenia" — never "schizo/mad/psycho" (COM M5!). Words
decide help-seeking — stigma kills quietly (M06.2!).
LINKS: COM suicide/psychosis · GER delirium/dementia · NUT perinatal.
MANTRA: "screen two, rule out medical, ask suicide, refer kindly."
